related.title: GRU：更新門慣例與狀態混合
related.titleEn: GRU: update-gate conventions and state mixing
related.why: 用兩課的可觀察驗收條件比較模型邊界：交付門控方程、三步狀態表與記憶偏導檢查。；2.2及2.4正確，門0保留c，序列邊界與狀態介面無混淆。
related.whyEn: Compare model boundaries using observable acceptance criteria: Deliver gate equations, three-step state tables and memory-path derivative checks.; Results2.2/2.4 match, gate0 retains c and state/boundary contracts are clear.
related.difference: 畫更新門與重置門在不同位置作用；本算例把候選固定，不能省略實際候選網路。；.55與.05正確且端點測試通過，公式慣例寫入介面契約。
related.differenceEn: Draw distinct update and reset gates; the worksheet freezes the candidate without removing its real network.; Results.55 and.05 match, endpoint tests pass and the convention is documented.
related.transfer: 保留單位與邊界條件，僅轉移可證明相容的驗證方法。
related.transferEn: Retain units and boundary conditions; transfer only demonstrably compatible verification methods.
practice: 簡化無忘記的單元c新=c舊+i g；記憶旁路局部導數1，門值的其他依賴另算。；教學c舊=2、i=.25、候選g=.8，改i=.5。；c新=2+.25×.8=2.2；改門值.5得2.4。
採h新=z h舊+(1−z)候選的慣例；不同命名可反轉z，必須與實作一致。；教學h舊=.8、候選=−.2,z=.75；改z=.25。；h新=.75×.8+.25×(−.2)=.55；z.25時.05。
比較兩個模型的輸入、誤差與驗收條件，記錄不能沿用的假設。
practiceEn: A simplified no-forgetting cell uses c_new=c_old+i g; its memory-path partial derivative is1, excluding other gate dependencies.; Teaching c_old2,input gate.25,candidate.8, then gate.5.; c_new=2+.25×.8=2.2; gate.5 gives2.4.
Use h_new=z h_old+(1−z)candidate; alternate naming may reverse z and must match implementation.; Teaching old state.8,candidate−.2,z.75 then.25.; h_new=.75×.8+.25×(−.2)=.55; z.25 gives.05.
Compare inputs, errors, and criteria; document assumptions that cannot be transferred.

related.title: Adam：動量偏差校正與首步檢核
related.titleEn: Adam: moment bias correction and first-step checks
related.why: 用兩課的可觀察驗收條件比較模型邊界：交付門控方程、三步狀態表與記憶偏導檢查。；2.2及2.4正確，門0保留c，序列邊界與狀態介面無混淆。
related.whyEn: Compare model boundaries using observable acceptance criteria: Deliver gate equations, three-step state tables and memory-path derivative checks.; Results2.2/2.4 match, gate0 retains c and state/boundary contracts are clear.
related.difference: 列step、g、m、v、mhat、vhat，將時間t與微批次數分開；只在optimizer更新時計t。；.2與.4首步校正正確，checkpoint往返保留step與兩個動量。
related.differenceEn: Tabulate step,g,m,v,corrected moments; count t at optimizer updates rather than microbatches.; Corrected moments match and checkpoint roundtrips preserve step and both moments.
related.transfer: 保留單位與邊界條件，僅轉移可證明相容的驗證方法。
related.transferEn: Retain units and boundary conditions; transfer only demonstrably compatible verification methods.
practice: 簡化無忘記的單元c新=c舊+i g；記憶旁路局部導數1，門值的其他依賴另算。；教學c舊=2、i=.25、候選g=.8，改i=.5。；c新=2+.25×.8=2.2；改門值.5得2.4。
mt=β1m前+(1−β1)g，mhat=mt/(1−β1^t)；零初始下首步mhat應等於g。；教學m0=0,β1=.9,t1,g=.2；另從零起始用g=.4。；mhat=.1×.2/(1−.9)=.2；另一案=.4。
比較兩個模型的輸入、誤差與驗收條件，記錄不能沿用的假設。
practiceEn: A simplified no-forgetting cell uses c_new=c_old+i g; its memory-path partial derivative is1, excluding other gate dependencies.; Teaching c_old2,input gate.25,candidate.8, then gate.5.; c_new=2+.25×.8=2.2; gate.5 gives2.4.

mt=beta1 m_prev+(1−beta1)g and mhat=mt/(1−beta1^t); at the first step from zero,mhat equals g.; Teaching m0=0,beta1.9,t1,g.2; a separate zero-initialized run uses g.4.; mhat=.1×.2/(1−.9)=.2; the other run gives.4.
Compare inputs, errors, and criteria; document assumptions that cannot be transferred.
